name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=load/chapter, descriptor=background_layers). No Ghidra address residue. Accurately describes the function: loads chapter-specific background layer graphics from FDOTHER.DAT into the static/animated bg buffers, branching on current chapter id.
purpose: Load the chapter-specific background layer graphics from FDOTHER.DAT into the global static/animated bg buffers, choosing one of three load shapes based on the current chapter id.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x2C) stack-check. Frees and nulls data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr and data_fd2_graphics_animated_bg_buffer_ptr. Defaults bg_width=0x1CE, bg_height=0xE2, fdother_idx=0x10. Dispatches on data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id: (1) Single-sprite default path (chapters 9/0x18/0x19 -> idx 0xF; 0x1C/0x1D -> idx 0x37; all other -> idx 0x10): static_bg_buffer = fd2_load_dat_resource(FDOTHER.DAT, fdother_idx), then animated_bg_buffer = malloc(64000) as a 320x200 work buffer. (2) 2-sprite widescreen path (chapters 0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B), with per-chapter overrides of bg_width/bg_height/idx_base (0x15: 0x198x0x114 idx 0x23; 0x16: 0x198x0x100 idx 0x28; 0x1B: height 0xF4 idx 0x2E; 0x11: defaults idx 0x10): malloc static_bg_buffer = bg_width*bg_height, blit top sprite (idx_base) at y=0 and bottom sprite (idx_base+1) at y=bg_height/2 via fd2_rle_blit_sprite, free the temp sprite, animated_bg_buffer=NULL. (3) Text-scroll cinematic path (chapter 0x17): malloc 0xEA00 (312x200=60000) static_bg_buffer, blit sheet idx 0x2A at pitch 0x138, free temp, animated_bg_buffer=NULL, then fd2_scroll_text_screen_up_by_lines(0) to arm the text-scroll cinematic. Chapters not matching any branch and not 0x1C/0x1D return early with both buffers null.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side-effect: populates data_fd2_graphics_static_bg_buffer_ptr (and, in the default path, data_fd2_graphics_animated_bg_buffer_ptr as a work buffer).

notes: Comment refine only: corrected caller count from 1 to 3 and listed all 3 callers in both the src header and the Ghidra plate (verified via get_function_callers + get_xrefs_to: all 3 are UNCONDITIONAL_CALL). No name or parameter change (void function, name compliant). No logic changes.
